note: Deployed on Pharos pacific-mainnet (chainId 1672). Overridable via SAFEHANDS_REGISTRY_ADDRESS / SAFEHANDS_ATTESTATION_ADDRESS env vars.

SafeHandsRegistry.description: Merkle-batched risk record registry. Operator commits batch roots; individual records are verified with Merkle proofs via verifyRiskRecord.

SafeHandsAttestation.description: Immutable attestations of SafeHands-verified broadcasts; powers the reputationOf trust signal.

writePolicy.note: No signing in the hosted deployment. Publish/attest require the SafeHands operator backend (not included).
